conflicts.item: Gas mass flow rate vs nameplate power
conflicts.values: Published US comparison tool states 273.8 g/h and 3.4 kW (11687 BTU/h); Published UK/EU data plate states 3.4 kW (252 g/h) across I3P(30), I3+(28-30/37), I3P(37), and I3P(50) with 0.85 mm, 0.90 mm, or 0.95 mm injectors (US/CA uses 0.95 mm at 11 in WC). Modelled check at propane LHV 46.4 MJ/kg: 273.8 g/h * 46.4 kJ/g / 3600 s/h = 3.53 kW; 252 g/h * 46.4 kJ/g / 3600 s/h = 3.25 kW; 3.4 kW requires 263.8 g/h at LHV (or 244.8 g/h at ~50 MJ/kg gross CV).
conflicts.use: Use 3.4 kW as the thermal design target and 273.8 g/h as the conservative LPG bottle draw rate. Do not fabricate a DIY gas train; buy a certified AS/NZS 5601 LPG burner, injector, flame-failure valve, hose, and regulator assembly rated around 3.4 to 3.7 kW.

conflicts.values: Published product page states 12.0 kg oven (14.8 kg packed); Published US comparison tool states 26.4 lb (11.97 kg).
conflicts.use: Use 12.0 kg for structural and portability calculations.

Inferred as asymmetric because the left wall houses the lateral gas burner tube and ignition assembly while the right wall holds only insulation and skin).

Because Arc Lite has no flue, 297 mm is the solid body height, unlike Dome XL where 997 mm includes a tall removable flue).

This is lower than the 0.63 Neapolitan rule-of-thumb heuristic, creating a 150 - 85 = 65 mm deep overhead hot-gas trap to retain rolling flame heat while venting flue gases out the upper mouth opening).

conflicts.item: Gas power vs mass flow rate
conflicts.values: Published spec sheet states 3.7 kW and 273.8 g/h at 30/37/50 mbar; Published US technical manual states 12500 BTU/h (3.66 kW) with 0.98 mm injector at 11 in WC propane; Published US comparison tool states 3.7 kW (12621 BTU/h) and 273 g/h. Modelled check at propane LHV 46.4 MJ/kg: 273.8 g/h * 46.4 kJ/g / 3600 s/h = 3.53 kW; 3.7 kW requires 287.1 g/h at LHV (at ~50 MJ/kg gross CV, 273.8 g/h equals ~3.80 kW).
conflicts.use: Treat 3.7 kW as the nameplate thermal output and 273.8 g/h as the spec-sheet mass flow. Purchase a complete certified LPG burner/valve/regulator assembly to AS/NZS 5601.

conflicts.item: Oven mass and marketing weight-reduction claims
conflicts.values: Published spec sheet states 13.5 kg (16 kg packed); Published US comparison tool states 29.7 lb (13.47 kg); Published US manual placement note states support surface must hold 14 kg. Marketing claims both 'about 33% lighter than Roccbox' and '25% lighter than Roccbox or Arc'.
conflicts.use: Use 13.5 kg as the dry appliance mass and 14.0 kg minimum as the support-surface structural load.

conflicts.use: Do not assign 125 mm to the internal baking chamber (which is Published as 310 x 380 x 150 mm with an 85 mm mouth); treat 125 mm as an unassigned external trim/dock/handle callout.

conflicts.values: Published US comparison tool states 40-45 min; Published EU spec sheet states 15 min to 300 C, 30 min to 400 C, and 60 min to 500 C.
conflicts.use: Use 60 min to reach a fully soaked 500 C stone. Modelled thermal storage check: a 724 x 543 x 30 mm cordierite slab (volume ~0.01179 m3, mass ~24.76 kg at 2100 kg/m3, cp 950 J/kgK) requires 24.76 kg * 0.95 kJ/kgK * 480 K = 11.29 MJ just to raise the stone by 480 K, which takes time to conduct through 30 mm (k = 2.2 W/mK, characteristic diffusion time L^2 / alpha = 0.03^2 / (2.2 / (2100 * 950)) = 816 s ~ 13.6 min minimum thermal relaxation time).

conflicts.item: Gas power, units, and mass flow rate
conflicts.values: Published EU manual states 10.6 kW (784 g/h) for I3P(50/37/30); Published US manual states 36850 BTU/h (10.80 kW) with 1.86 mm injector at 11 in WC; Published US comparison tool states 10.6 kW (36100 BTU/h) and 0.75 kg/h (750 g/h); Published EU spec sheet writes '10.6 kWh | 0.75 kg/h' (where kWh is a unit typo for kW). Modelled check at propane LHV 46.4 MJ/kg: 750 g/h = 9.67 kW; 784 g/h = 10.11 kW; 10.6 kW requires 822.4 g/h at LHV (or ~763 g/h at ~50 MJ/kg gross CV).
conflicts.use: Use 10.6 kW as the nameplate thermal design power and 784 to 822 g/h as the LPG supply and cylinder vaporisation design rate. Buy a certified AS/NZS 5601 / AGA-approved commercial burner train; do not build a DIY gas valve or injector.

conflicts.values: Published spec-sheet drawing callouts include 219 mm and 543 mm alongside 997, 697, and 946 mm. 543 mm matches the Published internal depth (543 mm), whereas 219 mm is unassigned in the text.
conflicts.use: Keep 219 mm as a named unknown with two hypotheses: Hypothesis 1 (Accepted as plausible CAD reference) is that 219 mm measures an external sub-feature such as the lower base/dock skirt height or the mouth/landing projection; Hypothesis 2 (Rejected) is that 219 mm is the internal vault height or the removable flue height above the carton (rejected as internal height because internal height is explicitly Published as 238 mm, and rejected as the sole removable flue height because 997 mm total height minus 219 mm = 778 mm body height, which cannot fit inside the Published 613 mm tall shipping carton).

What this cannot mean: It cannot mean 759 mm of solid floor-and-roof insulation, because the oven ships inside a Published 1077 x 815 x 613 mm carton with the flue pipe, flue collar, flue top, and flue cap detached. Using an Inferred solid body height of 520 mm (allowing 613 - 520 = 93 mm for top/bottom carton packaging), the true solid vertical stack (base + under-stone insulation + 30 mm stone + over-dome 3-layer insulation + shells) is 520 mm - 238 mm = 282 mm.

shared_mechanism: All three ovens use a lateral gas burner mounted at hearth level on the left side (Published as lateral gas in the comparison tool and described in the Arc Lite lighting instructions) that fires a yellow/orange diffusion-biased flame upward against the curved 304 stainless steel inner wall so buoyancy and momentum carry the flame in a continuous roll across the 150 mm (Arc Lite, Tread) or 238 mm (Dome XL) vault ceiling, heating the 12 mm or 30 mm cordierite stone from above by view-factor radiation while the 65 mm (Arc Lite, Tread) or 98 mm (Dome XL) drop from the crown apex to the mouth lintel dams the buoyant hot gas layer before spent products spill out the upper mouth (Arc Lite, Tread) or into the overhead flue collar (Dome XL); when the Dome XL is operated on kiln-dried hardwood instead of gas, the established fire is pushed to the opposite (right) side over the under-bed duct grate to drive the same ceiling flame roll from right to left.
do_not_treat_as_measured: Exact sheet metal gauges for inner 304 liners, SPCC pressings, and aluminised steel shells (Inferred as 0.8 to 2.0 mm; not Published).
